items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: He was, uh, he was the first drummer played with, uh, Edward Clinton.

ctx.x: He was, uh, he was the first drummer played with, uh, Edward Clinton. Yeah, his mama had a cook shop. His mama had a cook shop on, on, was it Frank, Liberty Street, Max Liberty, Saratoga. By Rischak? About a school. You know where that Arthur Williams School was? Uh-huh. Right in the middle of the block. That's why we called him Cook Shop Son. But every time we needed him we had to go by the cook shop and get him in.
Yeah, well let's see, where was Henry Martin from?
